messages:
Nina S: Quick idea 
Propose a 'fastpass' inbound path: UI claim returns instantly (10s TTL), enrichment runs async. If enrichment hasn't completed by 7s move lead to 'overspill' queue so SDRs don't wait. Thoughts? :bolt:

Cal O: +1, keeps UX snappy. Q: how do we avoid double-assigns when overspill triggers and RR pool is active?

Ravi P: Locking via reservation token. When we create a fastpass claim we set reserved_until = now + 45s and reserved_by = token. RR ignores reserved entries. If enrichment finishes we flip to active; if overspill finalizes we release and assign via overflow rules.

WebhookBot: webhook received for contact c_771 status: delivered (source: webinar)

Nina S: Also: dedupe by canonical key (email + intake_hash) before claiming. Late HS/SF webhooks should run through a reconciler that merges fields but doesnt overwrite owner if claim is active.

Cal O: Metrics: fastpass.latency_p95, fastpass.overspill_rate, fastpass.reconcile_late_count. Alert if overspill_rate > 1% for 5m.

Ravi P: Ops playbook stub: how to force-release a reservation; how to move a lead from overspill back to main queue; signal to SDR slack channel. I'll write it and drop in this thread.

Nina S: Action items: Ravi prototypes reservation TTL logic, Cal adds metrics and alerts, Ill draft the SDR FAQ and the small playbook. Target: staging canary next Tue. :white_check_mark:
